mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel (member_id, name, description) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.sql: c.id, c.member_id, c.name, c.description, c.stream_key_hash, c.stream_key_prefix, c.title, c.demo, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM broadcast b WHERE (CASE WHEN b.ended_at IS NULL THEN b.channel_id END) = c.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS live
mapper.update: UPDATE channel SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE channel SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE channel SET demo = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE channel SET stream_key_hash = #{hash}, stream_key_prefix = #{prefix} WHERE id = #{id}
